text: uh well this is actually something that goes with the tree painter and grass painter. is a bit of a rework on where the painting lives. heres the problem: i want to place grass, and tree inside of the grass. the current approach says i have 1 layer that i have to make a decision for this here. so either we need to introduce layering to the tile painter or need to put things into a different system. why does any of this matter for water, well think about what sits under water. either sand, rocks, cement. and because heightfields already control depth, water needs to arrive in two forms. the first, it needs to have its own tile painting for placement, but we need to also fill in for the heightfield in the space if its negative. so if i have a negative heightfield space and then i paint water tiles, that water should fill it. but we also will want to have swimming pools later on that will use the same water which pools will be through props and not this approach
